scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mferland/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @mferland/server" "npm run dev -w @mferland/web"
scripts.web:test: npm run build -w @mferland/shared && npm run test -w @mferland/web
scripts.crypto:test:local: npm run shared:test && npm run chain:test && npm run web:test && npm run crypto:browser:local
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mferland/shared && npm run build -w @mferland/server && npm run build -w @mferland/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mferland/shared && npm run build -w @mferland/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mferland/server && npm run typecheck -w @mferland/web && npm run typecheck -w @mferland/agent
